name: HERE Maps
label: HERE Maps
description: HERE Maps official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: geocode, reverse, discover, route. Docs: https://docs.here.com/geocoding-and-search/docs/request-constructing. HERE developer terms. API key (apiKey query). Attribution required. Geocoding & Search v7 hosts *.search.hereapi.com/v1; Routing v8 is router.hereapi.com/v8/routes. Hosts differ per SKU; paths are host+path because OfficialApiNode has one baseUrl. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One HERE Maps request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"geocode"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: geocode | reverse | discover | route. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'geocode'.

schema.label: at
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `at` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: destination
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `destination` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: lang
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `lang` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `limit` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: origin
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `origin` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: return
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `return` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: transportMode
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `transportMode` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: geocode, reverse, discover, route.

configurationParameters.label: Apikey
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
